name: io.narrador/narrador
title: narrador
description: Turn PDFs, Word, EPUB and X posts into narrated audio with word-level timestamps. OAuth or API keys; narrador credits (no subscriptions). Seven tools: files jobs, X audio, voices, and account.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional if your client supports OAuth. Otherwise: Bearer <API key> (nrd_files_... or nrd_x_...).
